title: Whole-sample Met-A centred on 1 by Met-A's mix rule; held-out pass 9; every instrument explained in the field's terms
set_out: Settle the one-way offset in whole-sample Met-A on sequencing; measure every instrument's healthy centre and spread from held-out and never-used atlas libraries; write every instrument's explanation once in the field's terms; start the new sequencing report.
open_at_turnover: The molecule pass on the atlas's own 156 libraries; the 'where' stage; the Law Sphere's card inputs wired into its readings; the report's remaining pages; the sign-off audit; then the leukemia study.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Met-A's mix rule (GRP-019)
entries.what: Same-family spill counted as the main cell in Met-A's healthy expectation; other families only at or above the measured 0.05.
entries.outcome: 31 never-used atlas-type libraries: median 0.938 to 1.016, 27 of 31 within the GUM bar; on main (71d2275d).

entries.title: Own-type, share-rule and planted-mixture tests (GRP-019)
entries.what: The 49 never-used libraries read with the mix fixed to their own type, with two share rules, and 14 planted mixtures.
entries.outcome: The one-way offset is the small shares to relatives on sorted libraries; the mix route reads true mixtures correctly.

entries.title: Held-out pass 9 (GRP-019, GRP-017)
entries.what: All 137 atlas inputs read against the other donor half.
entries.outcome: Every levels reading centres on 1 (Met-A whole 0.994); the halves mirror each other, so one pooled centre stands.

entries.title: Which instruments need per-type ranges
entries.what: The 49 never-used libraries through the full chain on main with saved molecule counts.
entries.outcome: IAM-A, run excess, copy timing, the islands meter and the Law Sphere's hold differ by type; the others take one pooled range.

entries.title: OTH-069: every instrument explained in the report
entries.what: Each instrument's field-language explanation, its steps of IAM's Law and its credits generated from the instruments database.
entries.outcome: On main (520bd700); the three Met-A readings explained once (5eef178a); run-length fields on sorted libraries (a37168db).

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: The offset was the mix, not thin donors
entries.what: On a sorted library the Deconvolver's small shares to relatives entered the healthy expectation.
entries.outcome: Counting same-family spill as the main cell removes it; the molecules side with the Deconvolver where a label disagrees.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes and what caught them

entries.title: Cell types taken from the Deconvolver's calls
entries.what: Five findings used the chain's own calls as the 49 libraries' types instead of their GEO names.
entries.outcome: Caught by reading the molecule files' GEO names; corrected the same day.
